# OrbitX Launchpad

Agent surface for the pad at `/orbitxlaunch`.

- Create router: `/orbitxlaunch/create` — mode × quote × style × rewards × optional Yes/No
- Claim / sweep: `/orbitxlaunch/claim`
- Params: `/orbitxlaunch/params`
- OpenAPI: `/api/v1/openapi`
- Quotes: `/api/v1/quotes`
- Dry-run launch: `POST /api/v1/launch` (unsigned; never holds keys)
- Markets index: `/api/v1/markets`

## Live vs indexed

- SOL Pump create via `/api/pump-create` is live (including `holderReward: true` Track A).
- Non-SOL quotes, create_v2 QuoteControl, Dutch/batch/IDO venues, Track B epoch vault, and on-chain Yes/No (pm-core) are **indexed + honest 400/501** until those programs are live.
- Predict markets are geo-gated (off in US until legal review). Self-attest 18+ required.
- Email/Google stay enabled globally. Only pad create requires X + wallet.

## Safety

Refuse cashback, hidden mint authority, ToCreator LP default, mayhem+stock.
Vanity grind max 5 chars. Destination of sweep is always the creator, never the payer.
